thread:
emma: Quick heads-up — QuantShop trial kickoff scheduled for Tue 10:00am PT. Customer contact Sarah has asked for a concise Day‑0 playbook + success criteria doc. Can SE + Security join?

raj_se: I can join. To scope evals I need clarity on prompt types (summarization vs rerank vs chat) and sample sizes. Also need expected QPS/concurrency for pricing.

sam_prod: I'll draft success criteria template. My suggested metrics: latency p95 < 300ms for gen, throughput target 60 QPS (burst 120), quality target per-use-case (e.g., resume-summarization pass rate >= 85%). We'll map to A/B and rollback triggers.

maria_security: Heads up: customer asked for SSO + IP allowlist + encryption (KMS). They'll send a security questionnaire. If they require private deployment or VPC peering that's a notable blocker for short PO C timelines.

emma: Sarah already listed three priority use cases in the intake: 1) resume summarization (generation), 2) internal search rerank (embeddings + reranker), 3) interview Q/A assistant (chat). She can provide anonymized samples for 1 & 2.

raj_se: For prompt/eval templates, here are quick examples to share with the customer so they can provide representative data:

```
# Resume summarization prompt (single-shot)
input: ``Resume: <TEXT>``
system: "Summarize key skills and 3-line summary suitable for a recruiter."
eval metric: pass if key_skills array contains N expected tokens, and summary length <= 3 lines.

# Rerank harness (embeddings + model scoring)
script: `python eval_rerank.py --input sample_search_queries.json --topk 10`
metrics: MRR, NDCG@10, latency per query (p95)
```

raj_se: Please confirm whether they want us to run hosted inference (fast) or a Dedicated/Private trial (longer procurement). That impacts lead time and pricing significantly.

ops-bot: Calendar: "Redwood — QuantShop POC Kickoff" invite created for Tue 10:00am PT (45m). Attendees: emma, raj_se, maria_security, sam_prod, Sarah (QuantShop).

maria_security: Quick questionnaire for Sarah to answer before kickoff:
- Any regulatory requirements (HIPAA, PCI, GDPR special controls)?
- Where will sample data live (S3, on-prem)? Will it contain PHI?
- Required retention / logging windows?

emma: She replied in DM: "no PHI, standard GDPR applies, legal will ask for DPA + liability limits." Also asked for pricing for a 3-month trial with reserved throughput vs PAYG.

sam_prod: For pricing presentation, I'll prepare two scenarios:
- Option A: 3-month reserved pool with committed throughput and a 20% discount vs PAYG.
- Option B: PAYG with usage cap and automated alerts.
I'll include estimated token cost per use case and a brief ops cost note for Dedicated.

raj_se: Action items (owner / due):
- raj_se: build eval harness + prompt templates, run quick smoke tests on a tiny sample — due Mon EOD.
- maria_security: send security questionnaire + KMS checklist to Sarah, note private deployment questions — due Mon EOD.
- sam_prod: draft success criteria + pricing scenarios — due Mon EOD.
- emma: confirm attendee list & forward sample data request to Sarah (1k resumes + 200 search queries) — due today.

emma: tagging the thread for visibility — please react :thumbsup: when you ack your action. Also Sarah: can you confirm which env (hosted vs private) you prefer for the trial?

Sarah (QuantShop): Thanks — hosted preferred to start, will upload anonymized samples to the S3 link you send. Also legal wants a DPA template before we ingest any data.

maria_security: OK I will attach the DPA + brief on encryption + IP allowlist steps in the thread before kickoff. If they want Dedicated later we can scope infra and lead times.

sam_prod: I'll convert the success criteria into a one‑pager and attach to the kickoff agenda. Plan to propose an initial eval window: 2 weeks of daily runs, then review.

raj_se: Sounds good — I'll also include a small `curl` example to run the smoke prompt against our hosted endpoint so the customer can sanity-check outputs before the official eval.

emma: Great — closing the loop. Final prep sync Mon 9am PT for owners.

(threads like this typically have short check-ins after kickoff — will update with notes and action completions.)
